newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil portworkers to draw up new wage proposal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil portworkers to draw up new wage proposal.

text.p: Brazilian portworker union officials will meet Thursday to draw up a counter-proposal to present to the government in the next stage of talks on the annual collective wage agreement, a union official said.
A government response on Tuesday to an original union proposal at a meeting in Santos was "not convincing", the union official said.
"We should have a meeting of union directors tomorrow to draw up the counter-proposal. At the meeting we should also decide how long to give the government to reply," he added.

Should there be no progress in talks in the coming week, portworkers have tentatively earmarked a national strike for July 14 but any stoppage has to be approved first by regional assemblies and the date may be changed, the official said.
"But everything depends on the government. There will only be a strike if the government wants it," he said.
